optimizedDescription.value: Workspace-bound ValidateSpecs cache port owns stamp/fingerprint freshness while hosts remain cache-opaque.

optimizedContext.value:
# Validation Result Cache Port
## Rules
- Abstract ValidationResultCache in application/ports; adapters implement behavior. One workspace identity per instance.
- Constructor inject same-workspace SpecRepository; never method argument. Use contractual APIs only.
- Persist all SpecValidationEntry fields: spec, passed, failures, warnings.
- Bucket valid only matching schemaFingerprint, non-negative engineVersion, invalidation state; invalid means miss.
- Store Spec artifact/persistedState/generatedMetadata stamps and cache-owned cacheFingerprint.
- cacheFingerprint hashes sorted-key JSON: specFingerprint from SpecRepository.specFingerprint(spec), metadataContentHash raw metadata bytes hash or __absent__. No third fingerprint.
- lookup: invalid bucket miss; supplied stamps avoids get; same stamps hard hit without hash; differing + same lazy fingerprint persists stamps then hit; else miss. List Meta/get stamps equivalent.
- Only hit entry or miss results. Methods workspace, lookup(spec/schemaFingerprint/engineVersion/stamps?), upsert(entry/spec/schemaFingerprint/engineVersion). No cacheFingerprint, refreshStamps, repository args.
- ValidateSpecs alone composes port; never hosts or FsSpecIndexCache.
## Constraints
- Export core ports barrel; runtime state; no schema evaluation.
